items.title: perf(ui): reduce blocking while opening chat (#194952)
items.summary: perf(ui): reduce blocking while opening chat (#194952) * perf(ui): split initial transcript measurement tasks Yield between initial visible-row measurement steps through the existing render lifecycle. Keep completion and cancellation owned by that lifecycle, and preserve complete Markdown and initial scroll positioning before reveal. The paired boot matrix reduces longest tasks without changing startup bytes, requests, transcript membership, or the retained window. * fix(ui): keep transcript placement ahead of first paint Limit task yielding to the initial multirow tail measurement ladder. Saved offsets, single-row snapshots, and other anchor callbacks retain their original microtask path. Keep cancellation owned by the existing render lifecycle and release a yielded callback only once. The first PR run exposed a cached-pane scheduler assertion and a saved reader first-paint assertion. The cached-pane regression now passes; local browser failures reproduce on the pinned merge base and remain recorded while the next exact-head CI run verifies the repair. * fix(ui): settle rail refresh after transcript resize

items.title: fix(skills): reject unreadable resource directories (#194635)
items.summary: fix(skills): reject unreadable resource directories (#194635) fix(skills): fail packaging when a source directory is unreadable The skill packager listed files with Path.rglob, which silently skips directories it cannot read. A skill with an unreadable subdirectory then reported success and replaced a complete .skill with a ZIP that held only SKILL.md. The packager now walks with os.walk(onerror=raise) and stops on the first unreadable directory. The existing excluded and staging directories are still skipped, and no-follow, containment, POSIX sort order and atomic publication are unchanged. Evidence: the packaged CLI as a non-root user in Linux Docker with a chmod 000 subdirectory, run twice on main and twice with this change. Main replaced an existing archive with a SKILL.md-only ZIP. With this change, packaging fails, the existing archive is kept and no new archive is created. Restored permissions, an unreadable excluded node_modules, symlinks and file modes give the same results as main. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/194635#issuecomment-6717021920. Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
